title: Pre-pass install proof (read-only)
table_note: read-only install proof: control socket status/integrity/policy, fleet-dsh unit, installed package identity digest + authorised wrapper, repo pin, repo r0-preflight. Dedicated fresh host/DNS/Supabase are owner acts, named out of scope.
expected: control socket answers status with integrity ok and lanes allowed; fleet-dsh active as user fleet; the installed release tarball hashes to its published digest; the wrapper reports the pinned DSH; the repo preflight passes every install-related check.

checks.name: control socket answers status
fleet-core identity
lanes allowed
integrity ok (chain, sandbox, rows, guard)
checks.detail: integrity.ok=true chain.ok=true verified_at_boot=44218 sandbox.ok=true rows.ok=true guard.ok=true

checks.name: control peer is uid 1000 (normal user, no root)
selftest flag on (fixture:true orders and selftest sessions are gated by it)
policy-get answers
policy pins spend ceiling + selftest
fleet-dsh unit active
unit runs as user fleet
unit is contained (ProtectSystem strict, NoNewPrivileges, egress IP deny)
installed release identity recorded from the install's own audit line
the installed release tarball is present and hashes to the installed digest
installed release version recorded from the installed release name (not assumed)
drop directory holds no ambiguity about what is installed (staged releases enumerated)
wrapper version runs read-only and reports a DSH version
wrapper status confirms the fleet install
dump-config exits 0 and mounts the fleet bundle rows
repo pin recorded
repo r0-preflight ran and every install-related check passed
checks.detail: exit=1 PASS=5 FAIL=1 → FAIL  company project id not recorded (R0 blocking: write id + region only, no secret)

checks.name: r0-preflight names its only blocking item as the company Supabase project (P5 owner act) if it blocks
checks.detail: exit=1 because project-id.txt is absent: the company Supabase project is a P5 owner act, out of scope for this strike (named, not silently skipped)

checks.name: preflight fails closed with no evidence supplied

findings.name: staged but not installed
findings.detail: The drop directory also carries cayleb-dsh-fleet-0.2.2.tgz, cayleb-dsh-fleet-0.2.1.tgz, cayleb-dsh-fleet-0.2.0.tgz — listed in package-identity.json but NOT claimed as installed.

findings.name: host
findings.detail: This pass runs on the platform host itself (outis-desktop), where the installed @cayleb/dsh-fleet release R0 resolved (version 0.3.0, cayleb-dsh-fleet-0.3.0.tgz, digest verified; source: journald install audit line (dsh-fleet-admin plugin-add) — what the install reports) is reported by the install. The real R0 also wants a dedicated fresh cloud host + DNS + company Supabase project: those are owner acts (R0-PROVISIONING P1/P4/P5) and out of scope for this strike by its anti-goals. They are named in the pass index, not skipped silently.

findings.name: no company state on the deploy paths
findings.detail: The generic preflight checked /srv/ergon /opt/ergon /var/lib/ergon /etc/ergon: absent (see preflight/absence-of-company-state.txt).
